name: Hetaera's Clutch
summary: Hetaera's Clutch is a sunken night elven temple dedicated to Elune, nestled deep beneath the churning waters of Azshara's Bay of Storms. Once a sacred site of devotion, the submerged ruins are now overrun by deadly hydras hatched by their broodmother, Hetaera. Adventurers braving the depths will find ancient stonework claimed by vicious aquatic predators.

sections.title: A Drowned Sanctuary
sections.body: Before the Great Sundering tore ancient Kalimdor apart, this structure served as a grand temple dedicated to the moon goddess Elune. Cast into the depths of the Bay of Storms, its stone pillars and sacred halls have spent ten thousand years beneath the sea. Today, all signs of holy veneration have been swallowed by the tides, leaving behind a solemn monument to the lost Kaldorei empire.

sections.title: Domain of the Broodmother
sections.body: The submerged sanctuary has taken on a far deadlier identity as the nesting ground of Hetaera, a massive multi-headed hydra who stalks the nearby coastal waters and rocky isles. Her numerous offspring, the Spawn of Hetaera, prowl through the ruined arches and corridors of the drowned temple, attacking any surface-dweller bold enough to dive into the bay.

faq.q: What was Hetaera's Clutch originally built for?
faq.answer: Long before it sank beneath the waves, this structure was a magnificent temple dedicated to the moon goddess, Elune. It was built during the peak of the ancient night elven empire before being cast into the ocean during the Great Sundering.
The Clutch rests deep underwater within the Bay of Storms, located off the jagged southern coast of Azshara.

Hetaera is a ferocious three-headed hydra who prowls the waters of Azshara. While her children infest the sunken temple itself, Hetaera is typically found swimming slightly to the north of the Clutch or basking on nearby offshore islands.

faq.q: What creatures inhabit the submerged ruins?
aliases: what mobs are in hetaeras clutch
faq.answer: The drowned halls are swarming with Hetaera's brood, vicious aquatic hydras known to defend their nesting site against any intruders who swim too close.

angles.text: For the night elves, seeing a sacred sanctuary of Elune submerged and desecrated as a nest for feral hydras is a painful reminder of the civilization torn away during the Sundering.
Aquatic druids exploring the depths of the Bay of Storms must remain cautious, as the hydras claiming this ancient sanctuary are extremely hostile to trespassers.
